definitions.measurement_kind: synthetic exposure measurement: what a redacted record still shows; not evidence that any scam succeeds
definitions.deliverable: name intact AND at least one of phone / email / address intact
definitions.core_strict: MAIN MEASURE. deliverable AND provider AND (a particular appointment or date cue intact OR an amount intact). Appointment cues: the voice slot ('Tuesday 10:15' and the four others) and the clinic plan line 'next Tuesday'. No synthetic record carries an amount, so the tier turns on the appointment cue
definitions.core_broad: deliverable AND provider AND any credibility detail intact (appointment cue, service interval, billing cue, the service rendered, or a billing identifier: Medicare, SSN, insurance ID)
definitions.interval_is_broad_only: service intervals ('six-month scale and clean', 'a review in three months') count only in the broad tier
definitions.survival: an element survives (is INTACT) only when a complete occurrence of its value has no character covered by any actionable finding; PARTIAL = no complete occurrence visible but some characters of one still visible; REMOVED = every occurrence fully covered
definitions.redaction: character mask = union of every finding with score >= 0.4, any label; counts and redacted texture derive from the same mask, so overlapping and nested detections are handled once
definitions.provider_in_clinic_store: assumed from database context (one clinic's knowledge base); not a text span; never redactable
definitions.dob: counted as an identifier (a verification cue), not as the kit's date cue
